methods.classified_water: Counts use retained publisher HUC12 attributes for ORW, ONRW, TN, TPGT and TPT. A complete exact-domain membership query supports zero matches for these selected classes. South Carolina jurisdiction is shown separately.
methods.geometry: Native receiving-water geometry intersections and routed load associations are computed by the receiving-water engine. Source attribute counts remain available for regional context and source inspection.
methods.hashes: canonical_sha256 hashes sorted compact UTF-8 JSON values. Source-byte membership hashes are preserved separately from the publisher companion.
methods.priority: A HUC12 is priority when at least one NRCS state row has FY26 status High Priority Area. Priority watershed area includes that whole HUC once; priority state area includes only designated state portions.
methods.roles: All original model-domain HUC12s are retained. Reporting and upstream roles are used only when explicitly supplied with native network records.
methods.state_area: NRCS st_ac is summed once per state/HUC12. State portions and watershed totals retain their published rounding or vintage differences.
methods.watershed_area: NRCS huc12_ac is counted once per HUC12. Repeated values across state records must agree. Acres convert to km2 using 0.0040468564224.
